notes.title: August update
notes.notes: [h3]Additions:[/h3][p][/p][p]Added new handicaps and skills[/p][p]Added music[/p][p]Added wild animals[/p][p]Added harvestable wild plants[/p][p]Added agility implants[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p][/p][p]Performance improvements[/p][p]Some clone behavior improvements[/p][p]Fixed issue with damage not being calculated correctly[/p][p]Effects now clear when enemies respawn[/p][p]Landmines now explode when shot[/p][p]Fixed a bug where Nexus was not finishing construction properly[/p][p]Fixed some more instances where clones would get stuck[/p][p]Fixed nitrogen pump audio not stopping when no power[/p][p]Game now keeps the custom resolution settings consistently[/p][p]Fixed a bug where a silhouette of an enemy would continue to burn[/p][p]Game now saves landmines and state of switched (on/off) objects[/p][p]Streamer laser now hits where the crosshair dot is pointing[/p][p]Increased flashlight brightness[/p][p]Enemy missile mechs do not destroy themselves while firing anymore, armor and HP bumped[/p]

notes.title: Save system and more
notes.notes: [h2]Additions:[/h2][p][/p][p]Added game saving and loading[/p][p]Added tutorial[/p][p]Added destructible trees[/p][p]Added armor, shield and implant[/p][p]Game length is now defined by number of waves instead of days[/p][p]Added instigator building (call waves early)[/p][p]Added stamina and oxygen meters[/p][p]Added wave info UI[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes: [/h2][p][/p][p]Fixed some situations where clones would get stuck[/p][p]Fixed a bug that caused weapons to stop working after the Streamer was unequipped[/p][p]Fixed some instances where certain audio loops would not stop[/p][p]Fixed some path-finding issues[/p][p]Fixed a lot of things I forgot to write down[/p][p]Fixed object pooler issue that was causing excess lag[/p][p]Fixed bug that made bullet casings stop being removed[/p][p]Fixed placement of farms[/p][p]Fixed weather audio volume control [/p]

notes.title: Demo is now available!
notes.notes: [p]It's buggy and unpolished but It will get better. Thank you for your interest![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43693496/e0a1f444195af11296430516b08fc3ef651f9351.jpg"][/img][/p]
